caption:
Three opening traps that catch Black: a smothered mate, a discovered check and a queen fork. One natural-looking move is all it takes. ♟️

Which one would have caught you? 👇

ig_caption:
Play Black? These three traps are waiting for you.

In the Caro-Kann, 5...Ngf6?? walks into 6.Nd6, smothered mate, because the e7 pawn is pinned. In Petrov's Defence, copying White with 3...Nxe4? and then 4...Nf6?? loses the queen to a discovered check. And the Damiano Defence, 2...f6?, falls apart after 3.Nxe5! and a queen check.

Each one starts with a move that looks perfectly normal. Check what your opponent's queen is lined up on.

Which one would have caught you? 👇

alt: Slide 1: Cover. Play Black? Three traps to know. One move, game over. A chess diagram of the Caro-Kann smothered mate.
Slide 2: Caro-Kann diagram. After 5...Ngf6, White's knight lands on d6: smothered mate, the e7 pawn is pinned by White's queen.
Slide 3: Petrov's Defence diagram. Black copies White, then 5.Nc6 gives discovered check from the queen and attacks Black's queen.
Slide 4: Damiano Defence diagram. After 3.Nxe5 fxe5, White's queen checks on h5, then takes e5 with check, forking king and rook.
Slide 5: A Chess Journey poster. The traps you fell for once are on the graph too.

slides.title: Play Black?
slides.moves: e4 c6 d4 d5 Nc3 dxe4 Nxe4 Nd7 Qe2 Ngf6 Nd6#

slides.title: Caro-Kann
slides.moves: e4 c6 d4 d5 Nc3 dxe4 Nxe4 Nd7 Qe2 Ngf6 Nd6#
slides.take: 5.Qe2 looks odd, but it lines the queen up with Black's king. 5...Ngf6?? is the natural move, and 6.Nd6 is mate.
slides.edge: The e7 pawn can't take: it is pinned to the king. Before developing, ask what the queen on your king's file is doing there.

slides.title: Petrov’s Defence
slides.moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nf6 Nxe5 Nxe4 Qe2 Nf6 Nc6+
slides.take: 3...Nxe4? copies White, but the e-file is now open. After 4.Qe2, retreating with 4...Nf6?? allows 5.Nc6+.
slides.edge: The knight uncovers check from the queen and attacks Black's queen at once. The safe reply to 4.Qe2 is 4...Qe7.

slides.title: Damiano Defence
slides.moves: e4 e5 Nf3 f6 Nxe5 fxe5 Qh5+ g6 Qxe5+
slides.take: 2...f6? guards e5 but weakens the king. 3.Nxe5! gives a knight, and after 3...fxe5 4.Qh5+ the checks begin.
slides.edge: 4...g6 5.Qxe5+ forks king and rook, and the rook on h8 falls next. Defend e5 with 2...Nc6 instead.
